description: This file defines a template class HashTableBase for high-performance, compact hash tables using open addressing with power-of-two bucket sizes. It includes detailed implementation of lookup, insertion, deletion, and resizing mechanisms, along with iteration support and usage examples.

classes.name: HashTableBase
classes.description: A template class implementing a high-speed, compact hash table with open addressing, supporting insertion, lookup, deletion, and iteration.

methods.name: NodeLookup
methods.description: Performs a hash-based lookup to find a node matching a key, returning a non-null pointer to the node for insertion or existing item.

methods.name: UpdateAfterInsert
methods.description: Updates hash table state after inserting an item, possibly triggering a resize.

methods.name: UpdateAfterRemoval
methods.description: Updates hash table state after removing an item.

methods.name: GrowBuckets
methods.description: Resizes and rehashes the bucket array to maintain performance.

methods.name: NodeClear
methods.description: Clears the hash table, freeing memory and resetting state.
